messages:
maya: Heads up — samplekit CI started failing after the latest typegen regen on main. A couple of auth/retry integration tests are flaky (timeouts + 502s).
raul: Which tests exactly? stack traces?
maya: auth-backoff.test.ts and auth-retry-coverage.spec.ts. Fail is intermittent but correlates with a small change in generated client types (order/hash changed).
tanya: Did the regen change the OpenAPI -> client mapping? That can reorder optional params and break runtime assumptions.
maya: regen-bot posted a short regendiff: looks like some interface field ordering shifted and a couple of helper overloads got regenerated with different signatures.
regen-bot: regendiff summary: 2 files changed, checksum drift on generated/types.ts (old: 9a7f2b, new: a3c1d9). Notable: param order in ClientOptions and a renamed internal helper: _requestWithRetry -> _requestWithBackoff.
sam: that rename alone could break runtime if code relies on private names in samplekit tests (ugh). But we never should.
raul: Can you paste the failing CI output?
ci-bot: ```
RUN auth-backoff.test.ts
  ✕ should back off and retry (200ms)
  Error: 502 Bad Gateway
  at http_client.ts:142:12
  at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:95:5)
```
maya: here's the minimal git diff from regen: ```diff
- export interface ClientOptions { timeout?: number; headers?: Record<string,string>; }
+ export interface ClientOptions { headers?: Record<string,string>; timeout?: number; }
- function _requestWithRetry(req) { ... }
+ function _requestWithBackoff(req) { ... }
```
tanya: The ordering change is harmless for TS (it's structural) but our sampleapp snapshots compare generated code text for release gating (regendiff check), which then triggers publish gates. The helper rename is more concerning — downstream samplekits import by name in a test harness.
sam: Ok two issues: (1) regendiff/text-change causing publish CI to fail, (2) runtime test relying on an internal helper rename. Both developer-experience bugs.
raul: Quick mitigation: pin the typegen CLI version in samplekit CI and add a stable sort step in the generator pipeline to avoid reorder nondeterminism. Also update tests to not reach into internal helpers.
maya: Agreed. I'll open a small PR to pin generator and patch tests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/412
regen-bot: Note: regendiff CI will still run if generated output changes. Consider adding an allowlist for cosmetic reorderings.
tanya: For the semver/changelog side — did the changelog rule trigger a publish-version bump? The publish gate failed with "no changelog entry for generated API change" which is expected if we change public surface.
maya: Right now the change is accidental; team consensus needed whether this is a patch (no public contract change) or a minor (API helper rename might be public). I think we should treat helper rename as internal => patch, but fix tests and pin.
sam: I vote for patch + hotfix PR to replace import usages. Then follow-up to make typegen more stable.
raul: I'll add a CI job to detect private-symbol references from samplekits (grep for _requestWithRetry) so future renames fail fast.
maya: Timeline: I opened PR 412 (pin + test tweaks). If CI green, I'll merge and then open a separate PR to revert the accidental rename at the generator repo (or bump minor if needed).
raul: Also file an internal engineering ticket to add stable key sorting in codegen output so diffs are less noisy.
tanya: Can we also update the publish gating script to ignore purely ordering-only diffs? Might be tricky but we can heuristic it.
maya: Noted. I'll add that to the ticket. Thanks all :thumbsup:
sam: Thanks — will follow up on the test refactor.
maya: Closing this thread once PR merges.
